ic_name: JESD204 Serial Interface for Data Converters (JESD204B/C)

fsm_states_link.name: RESET
fsm_states_link.description: Power-up/reset; link held; Device Clock and (Subclass 1) SYSREF establishing the LMFC phase.

fsm_states_link.name: CGS
fsm_states_link.description: Code Group Synchronization: RX asserts SYNC~; TX streams /K28.5/ commas; RX CDR locks and achieves character alignment on all lanes.

fsm_states_link.name: ILAS
fsm_states_link.description: Initial Lane Alignment Sequence: TX sends four multiframes aligning lanes and carrying the link-config octets (verified against RX configuration via FCHK).

fsm_states_link.name: DATA
fsm_states_link.description: User-data phase: converter samples (optionally scrambled) framed into frames/multiframes; /A/ and /F/ maintain alignment (204B).

fsm_states_link.name: ERROR/RESYNC
fsm_states_link.description: On disparity / not-in-table / unexpected-control / alignment loss, RX re-asserts SYNC~ (204B) to force re-synchronization (CGS again) or reports via the command channel (204C).

fsm_states_tx_framer.name: TX_MAP
fsm_states_tx_framer.description: Map converter samples into N'-bit words, S samples/converter/frame.

fsm_states_tx_framer.name: TX_FRAME
fsm_states_tx_framer.description: Pack F octets/frame, K frames/multiframe across L lanes; insert /A//F/ at boundaries.

fsm_states_tx_framer.name: TX_ENCODE
fsm_states_tx_framer.description: 8b/10b encode (204B) or 64b/66b block-encode (204C) and serialize across the lanes.

fsm_states_rx_deframer.name: RX_ALIGN
fsm_states_rx_deframer.description: Recover the clock, align on /K28.5/, then on the multiframe via ILAS.

fsm_states_rx_deframer.name: RX_DECODE
fsm_states_rx_deframer.description: 8b/10b decode (204B) or 64b/66b block-decode (204C); flag disparity / not-in-table errors.

fsm_states_rx_deframer.name: RX_DEFRAME
fsm_states_rx_deframer.description: Recover samples by lane / converter / position; release at the LMFC boundary from the elastic buffer for deterministic latency.

fsm_hints.trigger: RX asserts SYNC~ -> TX enters CGS (commas) -> RX de-asserts SYNC~ -> TX starts ILAS on the next multiframe boundary -> after four multiframes both enter DATA.
fsm_hints.rule: The LMFC (period F*K frame clocks) is aligned to SYSREF (Subclass 1) or SYNC~ (Subclass 2); ILAS begins on an LMFC/multiframe boundary so latency is deterministic.
fsm_hints.abort: Repeated decode/alignment errors re-assert SYNC~ to restart CGS (204B) or are reported on the command channel (204C).

anti_deadlock_rule: The SYNC~ handshake bounds CGS: TX streams commas only while SYNC~ is asserted, and starts ILAS deterministically on the next multiframe boundary after SYNC~ de-asserts; the receiver elastic buffer is bounded by the LMFC period.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: After reset, the Device Clock and (Subclass 1) SYSREF establish the LMFC phase; the receiver asserts SYNC~ to request CGS; the link then proceeds CGS -> ILAS -> DATA. Deterministic latency holds across power cycles when the LMFC is SYSREF-aligned.

default_ready_state_recommendation.TX_idle: Stream /K28.5/ commas (CGS) while SYNC~ is asserted; idle to the data phase only after ILAS completes.
default_ready_state_recommendation.RX_idle: Assert SYNC~ until character + multiframe alignment is achieved; then de-assert and accept ILAS, then data.

configurations.name: Multi-lane link (L=2/4/8)
configurations.description: Lanes aligned to a common multiframe boundary via ILAS and /A/ characters.

configurations.name: Subclass 1 (SYSREF)
configurations.description: Deterministic latency via distributed SYSREF aligning the LMFC.

configurations.name: Subclass 2 (SYNC~)
configurations.description: Deterministic latency via the SYNC~ timing aligning the LMFC.

timing_dependency_rule: All lanes share the Device Clock; the frame clock and LMFC are derived from it. The LMFC boundary drives multiframe alignment and elastic-buffer release; SYSREF/SYNC~ fix the LMFC phase for deterministic latency.
